note: Numbers are append-only. Never renumber or reuse a number; retire an entry with "retired": true and take next_number for new entries. stack = most per inventory slot. kind: material, tool, weapon, placeable. Numbers in 'tool' and 'weapon' are placeholders until skills exist. look_alikes feed inspection mode. durability = uses a tool lasts; wear is kept per inventory slot (server-owned). repair = materials one repair spends; a repair wins back half the durability. value = price of one item in COPPER (data/items/coins.json: 10 copper = 1 bronze, 10 bronze = 1 silver, 10 silver = 1 gold) (inventory sort; items without one count as 2). description: one plain line shown in the tooltip (job 75).

rock_pile.name: Rock pile
rock_pile.description: A heap of 45 stones. Set it down to store rock; pick it up to carry it.

wooden_hammer.name: Wooden hammer
wooden_hammer.description: A wooden head on a stick. The weakest hammer; it wears out fast. Nails and building still to come.

stone_hammer.name: Stone hammer
stone_hammer.description: A hafted stone hammer. It does nothing yet: nails and finishing work are still to come.

hand_saw.name: Hand saw
hand_saw.description: A bow saw. Keep it on the hotbar to saw a log into 2 lumber by hand, slower than a mill.

stone_adze.name: Stone adze
stone_adze.description: A hafted stone blade with a curved edge. It does nothing yet: smoothing beams is still to come.

rough_bed_kit.name: Rough bed
rough_bed_kit.description: A heap of thatch bound with twine and stakes. Set it down under a roof.

rough_bed.name: Rough bed
rough_bed.description: A rough bed of thatch. Lie on it to rest properly.

thatch_wall_kit.name: Thatch wall
thatch_wall_kit.description: Bundled thatch on a frame of sticks. Set it up to close in a shelter.

campfire_pot_kit.name: Campfire pot
campfire_pot_kit.description: A pot on sticks and a chain. Hang it on a small fire to cook stews. The fire stays at firewood.

campfire_pot.name: Campfire pot
campfire_pot.description: A pot hung over a small fire. It cooks while the fire is lit. The fire stays at firewood.

clay_hearth_kit.name: Clay hearth
clay_hearth_kit.description: Stones and clay built into a low hearth with a spit. Cooks better than an open fire.

clay_hearth.name: Clay hearth
clay_hearth.description: A clay hearth with a spit.

thatch_floor_kit.name: Thatch floor
thatch_floor_kit.description: A mat of thatch on stakes. The first foundation: walls and roofs stand on it.

thatch_floor.name: Thatch floor
thatch_floor.description: A thatch floor on stakes. Walls and roofs stand on it.

thatch_roof_kit.name: Thatch roof
thatch_roof_kit.description: Bundled thatch on a frame of sticks. Set it up over your walls.

thatch_roof.name: Thatch roof
thatch_roof.description: A thatch roof. It keeps the rain off.

thatch_doorway_kit.name: Thatch doorway
thatch_doorway_kit.description: A thatch wall with a gap and a hanging door. Set it up in your wall.

thatch_doorway.name: Thatch doorway
thatch_doorway.description: A thatch doorway with a hanging door.

wooden_bow.name: Wooden bow
wooden_bow.description: A bow of bent wood and twine. It needs arrows.

wooden_arrow.name: Wooden arrow
wooden_arrow.description: A straight stick with a fire-hardened tip and feather fletching.

stone_arrow.name: Stone arrow
stone_arrow.description: An arrow tipped with a flaked stone point.

quiver.name: Quiver
quiver.description: A hide tube worn on the back. Holds 40 arrows.

oven.name: Basic Oven
oven.description: A brick oven with a door. Bakes what a clay hearth cooks, and bread and joints besides.

oven_kit.name: Basic Oven
oven_kit.description: A brick oven, built with a hammer next to a clay hearth.

flatbread.name: Flatbread
flatbread.description: A flat cake baked on the hot clay. Plain and filling.

honey_loaf.name: Honey loaf
honey_loaf.description: A sweet loaf baked in the oven. Keeps well.

roast_joint.name: Rosemary joint
roast_joint.description: Meat roasted whole in the oven with herbs.

snare.name: Snare
snare.description: A loop of twine on a bent stick. Set it on a worn animal path.

snare_trap.name: Snare
snare_trap.description: A snare set on the ground.

kindling.name: Kindling
kindling.description: Small dry twigs and shavings. Catches a spark and starts a fire.

flint.name: Flint
flint.description: A hard grey stone that throws sparks when struck. Common near rivers.

pyrite.name: Pyrite
pyrite.description: A brassy, heavy stone. Struck with flint it throws good sparks.

obsidian.name: Obsidian
obsidian.description: Black volcanic glass. Breaks into razor-sharp edges, and is prized.

processed_hide.name: Processed hide
processed_hide.description: A hide scraped clean of flesh and hair, ready for the tannery.

fine_leather.name: Fine leather
fine_leather.description: The best of a batch of leather, soft and even.

heavy_leather.name: Heavy leather
heavy_leather.description: Thick, stiff leather for armour and harness.

rivets.name: Rivets
rivets.description: Small iron pins that hold layers of leather or metal together.

copper_ingot.name: Copper ingot
copper_ingot.description: Smelted copper. Soft, but good for early tools.

tin_ingot.name: Tin ingot
tin_ingot.description: Smelted tin. Mixed with copper it makes bronze.

bronze_ingot.name: Bronze ingot
bronze_ingot.description: Copper and tin melted together. Harder than copper.

flour.name: Flour
flour.description: Ground grain. The start of bread.

yeast.name: Yeast
yeast.description: A frothy starter that makes dough rise and ale ferment.

salt.name: Salt
salt.description: Keeps meat and fish from spoiling.
